_comment.description: Agent model and thinking level assignments scale with project complexity across three profiles. Re-evaluate at each complexity boundary.

simple_s1_s4.trigger: Python dataclasses, in-memory DB, single process
simple_s1_s4.changes: baseline — Pro for reasoning phases, Flash for execution, thinking off/minimal for mechanical agents

intermediate_s5_s8.trigger: Docker, microservices, FastAPI, Redis, RabbitMQ, CI/CD, LLMs/RAG
intermediate_s5_s8.changes: sdd-design→high, reviewer→high, oracle→high, sdd-tasks→medium, sdd-apply→low, worker→low, researcher→medium

advanced_s9_s12.trigger: Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka, JWT, Prometheus, distributed tracing, AI agents

_comment.deepseek_note: DeepSeek collapses thinking levels: off→disabled, minimal/low/medium/high→'high' effort, xhigh→'max' effort. Semantic levels preserved for future model migration.
